# mistertranslation.com — crawling is allowed everywhere.
# (This file changes nothing about what crawlers may read; with no robots.txt at
# all the default is already "crawl everything". It exists only to advertise the
# sitemap below.)

User-agent: *
Allow: /

# The Bible project. Regenerated by build.py on every build; the 3,800+ /v/ verse
# stubs are deliberately absent because they are noindex + canonicalised to their
# chapter, and listing them here would be a reported error.
Sitemap: https://mistertranslation.com/sitemap.xml

# /travel/ is a separate publication that is deliberately not linked from
# anywhere on this site, so a crawler has no path to it. This is how it gets
# found. Delete the line if you would rather it stayed link-only.
Sitemap: https://mistertranslation.com/travel/sitemap.xml

# /finance/ — The Librarian's Ledger. Same arrangement: a third publication on the
# same domain, linked from neither of the other two, found only through this line.
Sitemap: https://mistertranslation.com/finance/sitemap.xml
